When the parabola rolls on a horizontal line (let's say the board is the x-axis), the contact point on the parabola is at parameter $X$ where the tangent angle is $\phi = \arctan(2\alpha X)$. The parabola has been rotated by $-\phi$ so that the tangent at the contact point becomes horizontal.

$s = \int_0^X \sqrt{1 + (2\alpha t)^2} dt = \int_0^X \sqrt{1 + 4\alpha^2 t^2} dt$

This can be computed: $s = \frac{X\sqrt{1+4\alpha^2 X^2}}{2} + \frac{\text{arcsinh}(2\alpha X)}{4\alpha}$

The distance rolled along the board equals $s$.

After rotating by $-\phi$ (where $\tan\phi = 2\alpha X$) and translating so that the contact point is at $(s, 0)$ on the board (the x-axis), the vertex (origin in body coordinates) maps to:
